content.title: Top-100 Destination Universities - American Collegiate
content.text: Top-100 Destination Universities Some of the highest-ranking colleges and universities throughout the country offer recognized credits and transfer admission for students who successfully complete the American Collegiate program and earn a certain GPA. Below are some regional highlights of top-100 destination schools. Gonzaga University #80 National University (U.S. News & World Report) School Type Private Location Spokane, Washington (Pacific Northwest) Atmosphere Urban, in close proximity to forests, lakes, and rivers Size 7,563 students enrolled Degrees 49 majors with 60 minors and 50 different concentrations Gonzaga University, a Catholic, Jesuit, and humanistic institution in Spokane, Washington, is a top-100 national university* known for engaging instruction with expert professors and a supportive, yet challenging community. Gonzaga develops each student’s intellect, imagination, and creativity, and graduates become innovative leaders who shape and serve their professions and communities for the common good. Situated in the Pacific Northwest, Spokane is the second-largest city in the state (after Seattle), and one of the “Best Cities in the United States,” according to National Geographic Traveler magazine. The city is large enough to host bustling cultural, dining, and sports scenes, yet small enough to create an environment that’s welcoming, affordable, and easy to explore. Gonzaga’s campus, set on 152 acres in Eastern Washington, is surrounded by natural beauty—rivers, lakes, mountains, and desert—creating a truly picturesque place to study. *U.S. News & World Report, 2021 D19_514_Light_Quadding_2 nfs American University #79 National University (U.S. News & World Report) School Type Private Location Washington, DC (U.S. Capital) Atmosphere Suburban, 15-minute metro ride from downtown DC Size 14,318 Degrees 79 undergraduate programs American University boasts highly-ranked schools and colleges, internationally-renowned faculty, and a reputation for turning passion into action. AU students are actively engaged and committed to creating meaningful change in the world. Located in the nation’s capital city of Washington, DC, American’s campus—an accredited arboretum—combines the advantages of a traditional college setting with the energy, culture, and opportunities of a global capital city. Auburn University #99 National University (tied) (U.S. News & World Report) School Type Public Location Auburn, Alabama Atmosphere Suburban Size 30,460 Degrees 150+ undergraduate programs Auburn University has a rich history of excellence and innovation, including high-profile research partnerships with companies like NASA, renowned technology research centers, and highly-ranked academic programs. Designated a top-tier R1 research university (Carnegie Classification of Institutions in Higher Education), Auburn provides endless opportunities to build connections and gain hands-on experience. Auburn, Alabama is a lively university town with a charming, friendly atmosphere, offering endless opportunities to explore outdoor living and engage with the local community, from state parks to unique eateries. Atlanta, the largest city in the Southeast, is just 1.5 hours drive away and is home to America’s busiest airport and more than a dozen Fortune 500 companies. The University of Utah #99 National University (U.S. News & World Report) School Type Public Location Salt Lake City, Utah Atmosphere Urban Size 32,818 Degrees 100+ undergraduate programs The University of Utah is the state’s flagship research university. Designated a top-tier R1 research university (Carnegie Classification of Institutions in Higher Education), the U continues to develop groundbreaking research on the local, national, and international levels. Here, adventure is around every corner, driven by the imaginations of it’s students and brought to reality with the support of it’s faculty, world-class facilities, and resources. Located in Salt Lake City, the University of Utah offers a unique blend of nature, distinctive culture, and the taste of opportunity. The city is an active dreamer’s paradise. Set in the foothills of the Wasatch Mountain range, it is ideal for both studying and exploring.
